CAREERHUB SMART CONNECTIONS™
Know before you connect

No more “Who is this guy?” networking!

Most professional networks focus on how many connections you have and who is a first or second level connection. In their broken model, friends of bad connections become new suggested connections. CareerHub Smart Connections™ is better - CareerHub Smart Connections focuses on how valuable and relevant those connections could be.

Before you connect with someone, CareerHub shows you a Connection Quality Score™—giving you insight into the potential strength of the professional connection before you decide to add them to your network.

See connection value before you connect
